commands: git status --porcelain; echo "---ENV---"; echo "run_id=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-UNSET} attempt=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-UNSET}"; echo "---BASE---"; scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  :
else
  echo "SNAPSHOT-FAILED" >&2
  rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" 2>/dev/null
  printf '%s\n' disabled > ".prflow …[per-command-truncated]

for f in devflow-implement devflow-runner devflow.yml; do
  fn=".github/workflows/$f"; [ "$f" = "devflow.yml" ] && fn=".github/workflows/devflow.yml"
  git show 653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:$fn | grep -A4 'warned_env_keys=' | sha256sum
done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
for f in devflow-implement.yml devflow-runner.yml devflow.yml; do
  echo "=== $f ==="
  git show 653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:.github/workflows/$f | grep -n 'warned_env_keys\|denied_env_keys\|Inject-provider' | head -20
done

git show 653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:.github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml > /tmp/imp.yml && git show 653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:.github/workflows/devflow-runner.yml > /tmp/run.yml && git show 653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:.github/workflows/devflow.yml > /tmp/dev.yml && echo done

for f in devflow-implement.yml devflow-runner.yml devflow.yml; do
  echo "=== $f ==="
  git show "653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:.github/workflows/$f" | grep -A3 'warned_env_keys=' | md5sum
done

for f in devflow-implement.yml devflow-runner.yml devflow.yml; do git show 653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:.github/workflows/$f | grep -A1 'warned_env_keys=' | grep -c 'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL","API_TIMEOUT_MS","HOME","RUNNER_TEMP'; done; echo "---run.sh anchors at head---"; git show 653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:lib/test/run.sh | grep -c "denied_env_keys=/s/.*ascii_upcase"; git show 653b81db49c7935d6c44eb6c154165a86886feae:lib/test/run.sh | grep -c "warned_env_keys=/s/.*ascii_upc …[per-command-truncated]
